SELECT join_date, count(*) AS version_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys, sum(is_current::INT) AS current_rows, min(member_id) mn, max(member_id) mx, min(valid_from) vf_min, max(valid_from) vf_max
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-20' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT min(join_date) mn, max(join_date) mx, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT member_id) ids, (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) max_sale, (SELECT max(valid_from) FROM dim_member) max_vf FROM dim_member

WITH first_v AS (SELECT member_id, min(valid_from) first_valid, min(join_date) min_jd, max(join_date) max_jd, count(*) versions FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'jd_varies' k, count(*) FROM first_v WHERE min_jd<>max_jd
UNION ALL SELECT 'first_valid_25', count(*) FROM first_v WHERE first_valid=DATE '2026-09-25'
UNION ALL SELECT 'first_valid_25_jd_not_25', count(*) FROM first_v WHERE first_valid=DATE '2026-09-25' AND min_jd<>DATE '2026-09-25'
UNION ALL SELECT 'jd_25_first_valid_not_25', count(*) FROM first_v WHERE min_jd=DATE '2026-09-25' AND first_valid<>DATE '2026-09-25'
UNION ALL SELECT 'multi_version', count(*) FROM first_v WHERE versions>1
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_jd_25', count(*) FROM stg_member_updates WHERE join_date=DATE '2026-09-25'
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_jd_25_in_dim', count(*) FROM stg_member_updates s WHERE join_date=DATE '2026-09-25' AND member_key IN (SELECT member_key FROM dim_member)
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_total', count(*) FROM stg_member_updates

SELECT count(*) AS new_members, 
  (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member m WHERE m.join_date=DATE '2026-09-25' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_store s WHERE s.store_id=m.home_store_id) AND m.home_store_id<>900) AS unknown_home_store
